subject: MAP & close cadence — contingency lanes and new forecast
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@stargaze.io>, Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@stargaze.io>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft and shortfall forecast — immediate asks

Elena / Tom —

Quick note following today's product demo: based on the current evaluation plan and the procurement ETA you've shared (target PO in the week of Apr 30), our internal forecast shows a 2-week slip to the expected go-live for the sandbox pilot unless we take one of the contingency lanes below. I attached a proposed MAP_v2.xlsx that folds in the options.

Options we can take now (pick one):
- Contingency A (parallel pilot): provision a 30-day limited-data pilot using our EU-hosted sandbox to unblock integration testing. No additional contract changes, but we need a PO for baseline capacity.
- Contingency B (pilot-only agreement): a short-term pilot MSA for 45 days with restricted data scope and a capped token volume. Requires a security addendum.
- Contingency C (timeline rebaseline): shift go-live +2 weeks and add a technical readiness checkpoint on May 14. This avoids any procurement changes but requires exec sign-off on the MAP.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Confirm procurement ETA (firm PO date) or select a contingency lane.
2) Confirm the integration owner who will be available for daily standups if we do Contingency A.

I'll loop in our security and legal owners once you confirm which path you prefer.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx, pricing-calc.csv

Thanks,
Jordan
Sr. AE, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Park <elena@stargaze.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@stargaze.io>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP draft and shortfall forecast — immediate asks

Jordan —

Thanks for the summary and the options. Two quick items from our side that are driving the PO timing:
- Our security team is asking for documented KMS integration details and confirmation of data residency for logs (we have a hard constraint around EU residency for analytics logs).
- Procurement is waiting on final SOC 2 evidence and the redlined terms we submitted last week. Legal is reconciling the redlines now; procurement says earliest they can issue a PO is Apr 30 but it could slip to May 7 depending on legal.

Given that, Contingency B looks like the most realistic short-term path (pilot-only MSA with limited data scope). Can you provide the security responses and a pilot addendum draft? If that looks good, we can fast-track internal approval.

Also, our integration lead will be Samir Desai; he can join daily standups if needed.

Elena
Head of Data Platform, Stargaze Analytics

Rishi: can you own the security Q&A and provide a short evidence packet (~3 pages) and a pilot addendum template by EOD tomorrow?
Laura: we may need a short-term commercial concession (one-off pilot rate) to get this over the line; Marissa, are you available to approve a capped pilot discount if needed?

Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP draft and shortfall forecast — immediate asks

Jordan / team —

Attached a short packet (security-responses.pdf) that covers KMS options, data residency for logs, and the minimal evidence set procurement typically needs to sign a pilot MSA. Summary below:
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys via KMS integration; for Stargaze we can provision a per-tenant CMK (EU region) for logs and KV encryption.
- Data residency: analytics logs can be routed to EU-only storage and retention is configurable per account.
- SOC2: we can provide a redacted SOC2 report and the control mapping.

Commercially: to avoid re-baselining the MAP, propose a 45-day pilot MSA with a capped token allowance and a one-time pilot discount funded from our pilot budget (pricing-calc.csv attached). If procurement can't commit to Apr 30 PO, this gives them a runway without blocking the integration work.

Action items:
1) Jordan: run the pilot addendum by legal and get a draft to Elena by EOD tomorrow.
2) Laura / Marissa: if we need a discount >15%, we should escalate to finance — advise quickly.

Rishi
Director, Security & Compliance

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@stargaze.io>, Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@stargaze.io>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2028 16:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & close cadence — contingency lanes and new forecast

Elena / Tom —

Appreciate the fast turnaround, Elena, and thanks Rishi for the packet. Next steps and updated MAP:
- We've attached MAP_v2.xlsx with a tracked "Pilot MSA" lane that mirrors Contingency B. It includes the capped token allowance and a 45-day window starting on PO signature.
- Security pack attached (security-responses.pdf) and pilot pricing calc (pricing-calc.csv).
- If procurement can sign the pilot MSA by Apr 30, we keep the current go-live target; if procurement slips beyond May 7, we recommend executing Contingency A (parallel pilot) to avoid pushing the production cutover.

Marissa: can you confirm whether we have latitude to offer up to 20% pilot credit from the pilot budget? If not, what's our hard limit so I can set expectations with Stargaze?

Elena: if you can confirm Samir as the integration lead and confirm the PO/PO-ETA by EOD Monday (Apr 16), we will schedule daily standups and lock resources. If you prefer we can open the pilot MSA immediately and you sign later — but procurement needs to approve the approach first.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx, security-responses.pdf, pricing-calc.csv

Thanks —
Jordan
Sr. AE, Redwood Inference
